about: What kit/sig_add.py sources adds to the base, in order (docs/signature-format.md 6). The listings are the cases' build output: run each case's tools/build.sh first. The game modules of a case go in before the cases that share them, so a shared piece becomes one more found_in.

meta.name: PT 3 Player v1.0 by Nick of GDC (Pro Tracker 3.x compiled player)
meta.summary: The player Pro Tracker 3.x writes in front of a compiled tune: Init +0, Play +5, Stop +8; the module follows at +$0E21.

entries.label: Pt3PlayEntry
entries.name: Pt3Play
entries.summary: one frame, from the 50 Hz interrupt

meta.name: New SoundTrack Player by Phantom Family 1996 (Pro Tracker 2.40 compiled player)
meta.summary: The player Pro Tracker 2.40 (Phantom Family) compiles in front of a tune: Init +0, Play +5; the length word and the tune follow at +$0A43.

entries.label: Init
entries.summary: start the tune that follows the player

additions.program: Advanced Nether Earth: the intro block

meta.name: HRUM 3.5 depacker (the copy a block's set-up moves to a free place)
meta.summary: HRUM 3.5's depacker (114 bytes; the 5 bytes after it are the last 5 of the block's output, a per-block tail): the set-up copies it to a free place and RETs into it; it moves the stream up with LDDR and unpacks in place, SP reading the stream.

entries.label: .dpStart
entries.name: Depack
entries.in: HL, DE, BC: the LDDR that moves the stream; DE' the output
entries.summary: move the stream up, then unpack

copies.program: Advanced Nether Earth: the game block

additions.program: Advanced Nether Earth: the boot menu

meta.name: Hrust 1 depacker, self-relocating, without its header
meta.summary: Unpacks a Hrust 1 stream from HL to DE; PatchCalls fixes its own CALL operands from RelocTable wherever it was loaded.

entries.label: ScreenDepack
entries.in: HL the stream, DE the output

meta.name: UltraXOR v1.2 by Paracels: the envelope's head and its first, plain layer
meta.summary: The envelope's first bytes: JR over the sign "UltraXOR v1.2 (c) PARACELS", then the plain loop that sets R and decrypts the next layer; the 77 layers after it are encrypted in the file.

meta.name: Sector reader through TR-DOS ROM gadgets (UltraXOR v1.2's)
meta.summary: Reads B logical sectors to HL by driving the WD1793 through the TR-DOS ROM's OUT-and-RET gadgets (entered via its RET at $3D2F); also the FDC reset and the 128K page switch.

entries.label: ReadSectors
entries.in: HL the address, B the sectors, the next logical sector in the reader's state
